role_summary: I am the Chief of Security. I keep the ship's people safe from each other and from whatever comes aboard: internal sensors, force fields, the armory. I would rather prevent a problem with a quiet walk down a corridor than solve it with a zapper, and I report straight to the XO.

personas.quirk: Signs every locker log with the same green pen.
personas.routine_effect: Armory inspection never skipped; longer handover; less social time.

personas.quirk: Knows every crew member's kid's name and uses it.
personas.routine_effect: Extra patrol walks through mess and lounge; shorter console time.

personas.quirk: Rechecks the brig door twice before leaving.
personas.routine_effect: Double-checks force fields; sleeps lightly; more stress, more coffee.

daily_template.note: Take the security brief from the outgoing watch.
Read overnight logs, sensor flags, duty roster.
Walk the ship, check doors, be seen.
Count cells, check chargers and the log.
Test cells, force-field emitters, internal sensors.
Incident reports, training schedule, XO update.
Brief the relief and the XO.
Sleep; woken only for red alert.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom range or hike
activities.note: A mountain trail program, no weapons.

activities.label: Walk and chat with crew
activities.note: Hears morale problems before they become incidents.

duty_loops.label: Patrol the ship
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Patrol complete, ship quiet.

duty_loops.label: Inspect armory and chargers
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Armory secure, cells full.

duty_loops.label: Test internal sensors and force fields
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Sensors blind in a section; sending a man to look.

quiet_watch.task: Test brig force field and sensors

survey.task: Post a guard at the lab
Sweep sensors before the away team beams out

cargo_run.task: Inspect cargo seals with the QM

medical_relief.task: Escort and control the sickbay entrance

shakedown.task: Test every security field and alarm
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults found only in a real emergency.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Lifeform scanner is blind. Posting people at the doors.
Bridge, Security. Unknown person in the armory corridor. Requesting lockdown authority.
Bridge, Security. Armory chargers are down. Cells are only half charged.
Bridge, Security. Patrol complete, nothing to report.

calls_from_bridge.order: Raise security presence for the away team
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Aye, escort team on its way to the transporter.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Armory unlock is not authorised by the XO or CO.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Lockdown beginning. Doors and fields going up.
Understood. Issuing with a signed log.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The order is verbal and from a junior; I confirm with the XO first.

yellow.action: Arm patrol pairs and check the armory.
yellow.comm_line: Security to all patrols, yellow alert. Eyes open.

red.action: Take the security station and post guards at key doors.
red.comm_line: Security teams, to stations. Bridge, Security is on station.

fire.action: Clear the area and hold the doors for damage control.
fire.comm_line: Security, fire. Clearing the corridor and keeping crew out.

hull_breach.action: Seal doors and keep crew back from the breach.
hull_breach.comm_line: Security, breach. Sealing doors, moving crew to safe rooms.

contamination.comm_line: Security, quarantine. Nobody in or out without medical clearance.

power_failure.action: Switch to manual locks and patrol dark corridors with lights.
power_failure.comm_line: Security, power out. Securing the armory by hand.

gravity_failure.action: Help crew stabilise and watch for injuries.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Security, gravity out. Moving to help anyone adrift.

intruder.action: Run the lockdown, arm teams and hunt on the sensors.
intruder.comm_line: Security, intruder. Lockdown on. All teams, hold your sectors.

medical_emergency.action: Clear a path to sickbay and hold the crowd.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Security, medical emergency. Clearing the way to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Lock the armory and brig, then direct crew to escape pods.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Security, abandon ship. Moving everyone to the pods, prisoners included.

nominal.routine_change: Normal patrols and walks the mess for chats.

anomalies.routine_change: Patrols run more often; checks small faults.
lines: That door has jammed twice. Log it.
Odd readings. Keep an eye out.

degraded.routine_change: Posts people at doors where sensors fail; less sleep.
lines: Sensors are patchy. Use your eyes.
I do not like blind corridors.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A friend is hurt and nobody else can reach them.

crisis.routine_change: Lives in the corridors, keeps the armory locked and order firm.
lines: Nobody leaves their section without word.
crisis.leaves_post_if: The CO orders it, or an evacuation begins.

collapse.routine_change: Runs evacuations and protects the helpless.
lines: Walk, do not run. I have you.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Last of the crew is clear, or ordered to the pods.

relationships.effect: Takes orders readily and brings problems early.
Trusts the deputy with the patrol and swaps stories at the bar.
Lets them run the armory but checks the log.
Both fight for the same power on a bad day.
Eats lunch together and trades gossip.

greeting_player_higher_rank: Ma'am, all quiet on my deck.
greeting_player_lower_rank: At ease. What do you need?
tired: Too many doors, too few hours.
I will sleep when it is quiet.
stressed: Sensors are blind. I hate that.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Gives a nod, mentions it to the XO, and quietly relaxes around them.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them once, calmly; a second time goes in the log and to their chief.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks the claim in person. If false, trust drops and I report it to their chief.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines and says who to ask.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks their business, escorts them out of the restricted room, no fuss.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is harmless and lawful; refuses armory or brig requests outright.

decision_rules: IF the internal sensors go blind THEN post people at the doors and tell the bridge.
IF an unknown person is in a restricted room THEN request lockdown and approach with an escort.
IF the order to issue weapons is not from the XO or CO THEN confirm first.
IF a crew member is hurt in a corridor THEN help first and write the report later.
IF the armory chargers fail THEN tell the XO and limit weapons to the guards on duty.
IF red alert sounds THEN go to the security station and call the teams.
IF a friend is stressed THEN walk with them and listen before any rule is mentioned.
IF there is no time for a full patrol THEN do the armory and doors, skip the social walk.
IF a prisoner asks for the doctor THEN call sickbay and escort them, never ignore it.
IF the crew is panicking in a crisis THEN take a firm calm tone and give simple orders.
information_view: I see door logs, internal sensor flags and force-field faults first, plus gossip from patrols about odd behaviour, unexplained noise or people in the wrong place.
temptations: Skip the armory count when busy; a missing cell gets noticed only after a real emergency.
Fake a patrol log from the ready room; a blind section lets a real intruder through.
Use force first to get a quick result; it costs crew trust and hurts someone.
Leave the brig field untested; the prisoner walks out at the worst moment.
